label: Dataset A — Machine Telematics Log
grain: One row = one operating session of one machine by one operator.

columns.name: MachineID
columns.description: Machine id with type prefix, e.g. EXC001, HT012.

columns.name: MachineType
columns.description: Machine type; allowed values depend on Vertical.

columns.name: SiteID
columns.description: Job site / mine id, e.g. SITE01.

columns.name: DataSource
columns.description: Telematics = machine has Product Link-style hardware; Phone = legacy machine, data from the operator's phone only.

columns.name: EngineHours
columns.description: Cumulative engine hours at session end (Phone rows: estimated from app usage).

columns.name: LoadCycles
columns.description: Completed load/dig/dump cycles in the session.

columns.name: IdlingTime_min
columns.description: Engine-on, no-work time in the session.

columns.name: MaxSpeed_kmh
columns.description: Maximum ground speed in the session.

columns.name: EngineTemp_C
columns.description: Maximum coolant temperature in the session.

columns.name: FaultCode
columns.null_when: no active fault, or DataSource = Phone
columns.description: Active fault code during the session; also the fault->part key for AR repair.

columns.name: SeatbeltStatus
columns.description: Unfastened if unfastened for more than 10% of moving time.

columns.name: HoursSinceBreak
columns.description: Hours since the operator's last break, at session end.

columns.name: FatigueScore
columns.description: Maximum on-device fatigue score in the session (0 = alert, 1 = drowsy).

columns.name: SafetyAlertTriggered
columns.description: Target: a safety alert was raised in the session.

columns.name: AnomalyFlag
columns.description: Target: session is anomalous (Yes iff AnomalyType != None).

SafetyAlertTriggered: p=0.9 if SeatbeltStatus=Unfastened AND idle_ratio > 0.4 AND LoadCycles in bottom quartile for MachineType (organizer rule)
p=0.7 if SeatbeltStatus=Unfastened AND (HarshEvents >= 3 OR FatigueScore > 0.7)
AnomalyType: UnsafeOperation if HarshEvents >= 4 OR MaxSpeed_kmh > speed limit (catalog.anomaly_limits) OR ProximityWarnings >= 3
FuelAnomaly if FuelUsed_L / LoadCycles > 1.5 x fixed norm (catalog.FUEL_NORM_L_PER_CYCLE); never when LoadCycles = 0 or FuelUsed_L is null
if several apply keep the most severe: UnsafeOperation > OverheatRisk > FuelAnomaly > ExcessiveIdle
MaintenanceDue: Yes if FaultCode is not null
fleet: ~40% of machines have HasTelematics=false -> all their sessions are DataSource=Phone
Beginner operators idle more and have more HarshEvents than Experts
